items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...they got Homer Eugene and Wendell Eugene, they're two brothers? [INTERVIEWEE] They'd be realistic to them. Where they from?

ctx.x: Yeah. A fella by the name of Val Eugene, he's a trumpet player. Mm-hmm. I played with him, put a good ball on him.
I wonder if he's related to these trombone players around town. What, they got Homer Eugene and Wendell Eugene, they're two brothers?
They'd be realistic to them. Where they from?
